Title: TomTom is expanding its partnership with Microsoft

Body.Content:
TomTom has chosen the Azure cloud as its preferred cloud platform for its enterprise. As a result, Microsoft will now be able to incorporate all TomTom's map and traffic data into a variety of scenarios across all Microsoft services.

Learn more
